## API

Everything below is imported from `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/combo-box`, `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/dropdowns`, as noted.

### `ComboBoxComponent`

**Selector:** `mona-combo-box`  
**Type parameters:** `TData = unknown`, `TValue = TData`  
**Implements:** `FormValueControl<TValue \| null>`  
**API reference:** [`ComboBoxComponent`](/api/combo-box/ComboBoxComponent)

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `allowCustomValue` | `boolean` | `false` | Allows a custom value to be committed when it doesn't match any item in `data`. |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` | `""` | ID of an element that provides an extended description for the input. |
| `aria-label` | `string` | `""` | Accessible name for the input. Describe what the combo box represents. Prefer a visible label, linked through `inputId` or `aria-labelledby`; without any of them, browsers fall back to the `placeholder`. |
| `aria-labelledby` | `string` | `""` | ID of an external element that provides the accessible name for the input. |
| `class` | `string` | `""` | Additional CSS classes merged onto the host element via `tailwind-merge`. |
| `data` | `Iterable<TData>` | `[]` | Collection of items to render. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Renders the component with reduced visual emphasis and removes pointer interaction. |
| `inputId` | `string` | `generated` | Id of the inner `<input>` element. Point a `<label for>` or `<mona-label for>` at it to label the combo box. A unique id is generated when it isn't set. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the combo box as invalid. When bound to a signal form field via `[formField]`, this is written by the `FormField` directive. |
| `itemDisabled` | `DropdownFieldPredicateType<TData>` | `undefined` | A predicate function or the name of the field that determines whether an item is disabled. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | `false` | Shows a loading indicator, in place of the clear button, and marks the field busy. It doesn't block interaction: the field stays usable while data loads. |
| `placeholder` | `string` | `""` | Placeholder text shown when no value is selected or entered. |
| `popupClass` | `string` | `""` | Sets the class of the popup element. |
| `popupHeight` | `ListSizeInputType` | `null` | Maximum height of the popup, in pixels or as a CSS length. Shorter lists shrink to fit. When unset, the popup is at most 200 pixels tall. |
| `popupWidth` | `ListSizeInputType` | `null` | Sets the width of the popup element. |
| `readonly` | `boolean` | `false` | Prevents value changes while preserving the component's visual state. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets the required state of the combo box component. |
| `rounded` | `"full" \| "large" \| "medium" \| "none" \| "small"` | `"medium"` | Border-radius preset applied to the component. |
| `showClearButton` | `boolean` | `false` | Displays a button that resets the value to empty when an item is selected. |
| `size` | `"large" \| "medium" \| "small"` | `"medium"` | Size preset controlling the component's dimensions. |
| `textField` | `DropdownFieldSelectorType<TData, string>` | `undefined` | Property name or accessor used to derive the display text from a data item. If not set, the item itself is used as the text representation. |
| `touched` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets the touched state of the combo box. When bound to a signal form field via `[formField]`, this is written by the `FormField` directive. |
| `value` (two-way) | `TValue \| null` | `null` | Two-way bindable current selected value. Implements `FormValueControl<TValue \| null>`, enabling signal forms `[formField]` binding. Object mode returns the selected data item; primitive mode (see `valuePrimitive`) returns the value resolved through `valueField`. `null` represents no selection. |
| `valueField` | `DropdownFieldSelectorType<TData, unknown>` | `undefined` | Property name or accessor used to derive the value from a data item. It is used for stable item identity, matching externally supplied values, and primitive value projection when `valuePrimitive` is enabled. When omitted, the item itself is used as the value representation. Should resolve to a stable, unique scalar. |
| `valuePrimitive` | `boolean` | `false` | Determines whether the bound value contains complete data items or values extracted through `valueField`. When `false`, selecting an item writes the complete data item. When `true`, selecting an item writes the value resolved through `valueField`. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `close` | `PopupCloseEvent<unknown>` | Emitted when the popup is about to close. This event is preventable. |
| `closed` | `void` | Emitted after the popup is closed. |
| `open` | `PreventableEvent<Event>` | Emitted when the popup is about to open. This event is preventable. |
| `opened` | `void` | Emitted after the popup is opened. |
| `touch` | `void` | Emitted when focus leaves the combo box. Moving between its input, clear button and popup doesn't count. The `FormField` directive listens to this to mark the field as touched. |
| `valueAdd` | `string` | Emitted with the entered text when the user presses Enter on text that matches no item, or leaves the field with it. Only emitted when `allowCustomValue` is true. |
| `valueChange` | `TValue \| null` | Emitted when `value` changes. |

#### Methods

| Signature | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void` | Moves focus to the inner input. The caret goes to the end of the text. |

### `DropdownFilterableDirective`

From `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/dropdowns`.

**Selector:** `mona-auto-complete[monaDropDownFilterable], mona-dropdown-list[monaDropDownFilterable], mona-combo-box[monaDropDownFilterable], mona-multi-select[monaDropDownFilterable]`  
**API reference:** [`DropdownFilterableDirective`](/api/dropdowns/DropdownFilterableDirective)

#### Inputs

| Name | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | `string` | `""` | Current filter text used to narrow the visible options. |
| `filterPlaceholder` | `string` | `""` | Placeholder text in the popup's filter row. Auto Complete has no filter row, since its own input is the filter, so it ignores this. |
| `monaDropDownFilterable` | `Partial<FilterableOptions> \| ""` | `""` | Filter operator, case sensitivity, and debounce delay. An empty string enables filtering with default settings (`operator: "contains"`, `caseSensitive: false`, `debounce: 0`); pass an object to override any field. |

#### Outputs

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `filterChange` | `FilterChangeEvent` | Emitted when the filter value changes. Cancelable. |

### `DropdownLiveRegionDirective`

From `@nanahoshi/mona-ui/dropdowns`.

Announces how many results a dropdown shows after its list is filtered, or after its items change, while the
popup is open ("3 results available", "No results found").

The announcement goes through the CDK `LiveAnnouncer`, whose live region lives at the end of the document, so it
never becomes part of the combobox's content. The highlighted option isn't announced here:
`aria-activedescendant` already does that.

**Selector:** `[monaDropdownLiveRegion]`  
**API reference:** [`DropdownLiveRegionDirective`](/api/dropdowns/DropdownLiveRegionDirective)
